experiences.description: I build custom websites that help clients—from schools to travel agencies—establish a strong online presence. I handle everything from design to deployment, delivering responsive and user-friendly web solutions tailored to their goals.

Completed an intensive 5-month bootcamp focused on full-stack development using React.js and Node.js. Gained hands-on experience through real projects, including building a complete e-commerce site, preparing me for real-world work environments.
Completed a comprehensive course on Microsoft Word and Excel, mastering both fundamental and advanced features for efficient document and data handling.

sub_1.title: Introduction
sub_1.p: Hi, I’m Khotami, a full-stack web developer with strong experience in building websites using Next.js, Laravel, and WordPress. I focus on creating clean, fast, and user-friendly web applications.

sub_2.title: Background
sub_2.p: I graduated from UIN Jakarta with a degree in Arabic Literature. While the field wasn’t my true interest, I completed it with responsibility and discipline. | After college, I explored several career paths — from teaching Arabic to trying roles in accounting and data analysis. But through that journey, I realized what I really needed was to commit to one skill and focus. | That’s when I discovered web development. With a proper laptop in hand, I began learning from scratch — starting with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, then moving into Laravel, and eventually React and Next.js.

sub_3.title: Skills & Tech Stack
sub_3.p: Over time, I’ve built real-world projects and mastered tools like:
sub_3.list:
Frontend: Next.js, React, Vue, Tailwind CSS, Motion
Backend: Laravel, RESTful APIs, MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL
CMS: WordPress (Elementor, Gutenberg, custom themes/plugins)
Familiar with Git, GitHub, hosting platform like Hostinger, deployment platforms like Vercel

sub_4.title: Work Values
sub_4.list: Writing clean and efficient code | Understanding the user’s needs | Learning continuously and adapting to challenges z| Being reliable and committed in any team I join

sub_5.title: My Goal
sub_5.p: My goal is to grow as a developer who not only builds websites that work, but also makes them fast, accessible, and enjoyable to use. I’m focused on building a long-term career in web development by delivering real value in every project.

sub_6.title: Personal Touch
sub_6.p: Outside of tech, I enjoy summarizing what I’ve learned, exploring UI animations, and spending time with playing chess and watching korean drama.

contact.title: Let’s Work Together
contact.p: I am always open to new opportunities and collaborations. Whether you have a project idea, a job offer, or just want to say hi — feel free to reach out.
